summary.headline: Two accounts have zero buying-committee contacts and the ICP tiers aren't defined anywhere — an AI would route on guesswork.
summary.narrative: Accounts carry an A/B/C ICP tier label but no documented criteria behind it, and Hooli and Wayne (both with open deals) have no buying-committee contacts at all. Define ICP as a rule and require at least one committee contact before letting an AI route or prioritise accounts.

findings.title: Hooli and Wayne have no buying-committee contacts
findings.what_we_found: Hooli (ACC-04) and Wayne (ACC-07) both show buying_committee_contacts = 0, yet both have active open opportunities (OPP-2004, OPP-2008).
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: An AI cannot reason about who to engage, who signs, or who to route to when no committee contacts exist — it would be steering deals at no one.
the_fix: Identify and add at least one buying-committee contact per account, ideally the economic buyer.
Require a committee contact before an account is eligible for AI-assisted routing.
Prioritise the accounts that already have open deals (Hooli, Wayne).
findings.evidence: accounts.csv buying_committee_contacts = 0 for ACC-04 and ACC-07.

findings.title: ICP tiers are labelled but never defined
findings.what_we_found: Every account carries an icp_tier of A, B, or C, but no field, doc, or rule states what qualifies an account for each tier. Tier A spans Software (Northwind), Aerospace (Stark) and Research (Massive Dynamic) with no visible common criteria.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: Without an explicit ICP rule, an AI prioritising accounts would either ignore the tiers or invent its own logic — neither is governable or auditable.
the_fix: Document ICP tier criteria explicitly (firmographics + buying signals).
Encode the criteria as a rule and re-derive tiers from data, not opinion.
Reconcile the ICP definition with marketing before an AI routes leads or accounts.
findings.evidence: icp_tier present but no criteria source; Tier A mixes unrelated industries.

findings.title: Several accounts show ARR of zero
findings.what_we_found: Northwind, Hooli, Soylent, Wayne, Acme Co, Massive Dynamic and Gekko Capital all show arr = 0, mixing genuine prospects with what may be stale or unentered data.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: An AI prioritising on account value would treat all of these as worthless, potentially deprioritising real opportunities — a zero may mean prospect, not no value.
the_fix: Distinguish prospect (no ARR yet) from customer with missing ARR via a status field.
Backfill ARR for current customers before an AI prioritises on account value.

definitions.definition: ICP = B2B software accounts, 250-5,000 employees, with a named economic buyer and a budgeted RevOps initiative.
definitions.derived_from: Inferred from Tier A account profile; no documented criteria currently exist.
